name: wibou-r-charge-loop-a
notes: Dash Slash (ground.R / air.R) charge loop for slot aimAnimationId, 2026-10-18. Variant A: coiled dash stance.
character: Wibou (37 joints; one index-finger chain and a thumb per hand; a 1.52 m katana fixed to the right hand as joint Weapon0 with bladeHilt and bladeEnd anchors)
description:
Wibou's Dash Slash charge loop. In the game the player holds R to aim and charge the dash (anywhere from a tap to a full second, and it can be held longer at full charge), then releases to dash forward and slash. Until now the charge played the dash clip itself, so Wibou ran and lunged on the spot while charging. This clip replaces that: a coiled, ready-to-spring dash stance that plays while R is held.

How the game plays it. The game crossfades into this clip over 0.1 s from idle or run and loops it (ticks 0-30, wrapping from 30 back to 0) for as long as R is held. On release it crossfades over 3 ticks into the dash clip (reference `dash`) at its tick 0, whose ticks 2-6 lunge forward and to the left, low, with the sword arm out to the right holding the blade about level (image 1: dash ticks 0-6 from the side, the three-quarter rear view and the front). So the stance must read as the instant before that lunge: from it, the dash's tick 3-4 pose must be a short forward continuation, never a pop back upright. Render the dash reference yourself (reference:dash, ticks 0-6) to match it. The same clip also plays in the air while Wibou charges and falls, so it must also read as a mid-air coil.

The stance (tick 0). Low and wide: sink the hips about 0.2 m from idle, knees well bent and pointing over the toes, feet planted wide, about where the dash puts them at tick 2 (left foot about 0.5 m to the left, right foot about 0.8 m to the right). Torso pitched forward 30-40 degrees and leaning slightly to the left, toward where the lunge goes; head up, eyes locked forward along the dash. Sword: the right hand low beside the right hip, the blade out to the right and angled back about 30-45 degrees behind the shoulder line, roughly level, the tip about hip height, well clear of the floor and the legs. Left arm forward and low in front of the left knee, hand open, for balance.

The loop (ticks 0-30). Small, tense and alive, not a dance: it should read as power building. The hips bob down and up 3-5 cm once per cycle; the chest and shoulders breathe with it a couple of ticks behind; the blade tip quivers a few centimetres twice per cycle as the grip tightens. The open left hand flexes slightly. The head stays steady and focused forward the whole time. Offset the parts so they never all peak on the same tick.

Identity: Wibou is an ironic mall-ninja weeaboo, a cringe Neo from The Matrix with a katana. The stance can be a little over-the-top anime (very low, very wide, very focused), but no props, no sheath, no spins, no step and no attack. The feet stay planted, the fighter does not move, and the blade never passes through the legs, torso, arms or head.
image_notes: 1: the current dash clip (reference dash) at ticks 0-6 on the real character: rows are the side view (front is to the right), the three-quarter rear view and the front view; the release crossfades from this loop into it. 2: the idle entry pose with the sword (profile, front, three-quarter rear).
